name: gently-perception-benchmark
description:
Gently Perception Agent Benchmark
	

Benchmark dataset for evaluating vision-language model perception agents on
C. elegans embryo stage classification from light-sheet microscopy.

	
		
		Overview
	

The Gently microscopy platform uses
Claude's vision capabilities to classify embryo developmental stages in real
time. This dataset provides the volumes, ground truth, reference images,
experimental results, and code needed to reproduce and extend the benchmark.
The accompanying technical… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pskeshu/gently-perception-benchmark.
evaluation_method: accuracy (per-stage classification; may also report F1 for class-imbalanced splits)
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark used by researchers evaluating vision-language agents on microscopy / developmental biology tasks.
